bible_quanes.question: How does Paul describe God in 2 Corinthians 1:3?
bible_quanes.answer: The Father of mercies and God of all comfort

bible_quanes.question: Why does God comfort us in our tribulation?
bible_quanes.answer: That we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble

bible_quanes.question: What are all the promises of God in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Yea, and in Him Amen

bible_quanes.question: What has God given us in our hearts as a guarantee?
bible_quanes.answer: The Spirit

bible_quanes.question: What trouble did Paul face in Asia?
bible_quanes.answer: We were pressed out of measure, above strength, and despaired even of life

bible_quanes.question: Why did Paul have the sentence of death in himself?
bible_quanes.answer: That we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead

bible_quanes.question: What is Paul's boasting?
bible_quanes.answer: The testimony of his conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity he had his conversation

bible_quanes.question: Who preached Christ among the Corinthians with Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: Silvanus and Timotheus

bible_quanes.question: How did the Corinthians help Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: By prayer for us

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say about the Corinthians' faith?
bible_quanes.answer: Not that we have dominion over your faith: for by faith ye stand

bible_quanes.question: What does God always lead us in?
bible_quanes.answer: Triumph in Christ
bible_quanes.explanation: Spreading the fragrance of His knowledge.

bible_quanes.question: What are we to God?
bible_quanes.answer: A sweet savour of Christ

bible_quanes.question: Of what are we not ignorant?
bible_quanes.answer: His devices

bible_quanes.question: What should the Corinthians do for the punished man?
bible_quanes.answer: Forgive and comfort him

bible_quanes.question: How did Paul write his previous letter?
bible_quanes.answer: Out of much affliction and anguish of heart, with many tears

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul urge them to reaffirm toward the man?
bible_quanes.answer: Your love

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul find opened at Troas?
bible_quanes.answer: A door by the Lord

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul not find at Troas?
bible_quanes.answer: Titus his brother

bible_quanes.question: What are we to the perishing and the saved?
bible_quanes.answer: The savour of death unto death, and the savour of life unto life

bible_quanes.question: What do many do with the word of God?
bible_quanes.answer: Corrupt it

bible_quanes.question: What is where the Spirit of the Lord is?
bible_quanes.answer: Liberty

bible_quanes.question: Into what are we being transformed?
bible_quanes.answer: The same image from glory to glory

bible_quanes.question: What are the Corinthians to Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: Our epistle written in our hearts

bible_quanes.question: What kills and what gives life?
bible_quanes.answer: The letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life

bible_quanes.question: With what was the Corinthians' epistle written?
bible_quanes.answer: The Spirit of the living God

bible_quanes.question: From where is our sufficiency?
bible_quanes.answer: Of God

bible_quanes.question: Why did Moses put a vail over his face?
bible_quanes.answer: That Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished

bible_quanes.question: When is the vail taken away?
bible_quanes.answer: When it shall turn to the Lord

bible_quanes.question: How is the ministry of death described?
bible_quanes.answer: Written and engraven in stones, glorious

bible_quanes.question: Which ministry exceeds much more in glory?
bible_quanes.answer: The ministration of righteousness

bible_quanes.question: In what do we have this treasure?
bible_quanes.answer: Earthen vessels
bible_quanes.explanation: That the power may be of God.

bible_quanes.question: What happens to the inward man day by day?
bible_quanes.answer: It is renewed

bible_quanes.question: What things are eternal?
bible_quanes.answer: The things which are not seen

bible_quanes.question: Where has God shone into our hearts?
bible_quanes.answer: In the face of Jesus Christ
bible_quanes.explanation: The light of the knowledge of His glory.

bible_quanes.question: Who has blinded the minds of unbelievers?
bible_quanes.answer: The god of this world

bible_quanes.question: Whom does Paul preach?
bible_quanes.answer: Not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say about being troubled?
bible_quanes.answer: Troubled on every side, yet not distressed

bible_quanes.question: What does our light affliction work for us?
bible_quanes.answer: A far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory

bible_quanes.question: What do we always carry in the body?
bible_quanes.answer: The dying of the Lord Jesus
bible_quanes.explanation: That His life may be manifested.

bible_quanes.question: Which Scripture does Paul quote about believing?
bible_quanes.answer: "I believed, and therefore have I spoken"

bible_quanes.question: How do we walk?
bible_quanes.answer: By faith, not by sight

bible_quanes.question: What is anyone who is in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: A new creature

bible_quanes.question: What did God make Him who knew no sin?
bible_quanes.answer: To be sin for us
bible_quanes.explanation: That we might become the righteousness of God.

bible_quanes.question: What are believers called in 2 Corinthians 5:20?
bible_quanes.answer: Ambassadors for Christ

bible_quanes.question: What do we have if our earthly house is destroyed?
bible_quanes.answer: A building from God, a house not made with hands

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul prefer?
bible_quanes.answer: To be absent from the body and present with the Lord

bible_quanes.question: Before what must we all appear?
bible_quanes.answer: The judgment seat of Christ

bible_quanes.question: What compels Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: The love of Christ

bible_quanes.question: What ministry has God given us?
bible_quanes.answer: The ministry of reconciliation

bible_quanes.question: What was God doing in Christ?
bible_quanes.answer: Reconciling the world to Himself

bible_quanes.question: When is the day of salvation?
bible_quanes.answer: Now

bible_quanes.question: With whom should believers not be unequally yoked?
bible_quanes.answer: Unbelievers
bible_quanes.explanation: What fellowship has light with darkness?

bible_quanes.question: What are we, according to 2 Corinthians 6:16?
bible_quanes.answer: The temple of the living God

bible_quanes.question: What does God call His people to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Come out from among them and be separate

bible_quanes.question: How do ministers commend themselves?
bible_quanes.answer: In much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses

bible_quanes.question: How does Paul describe himself as poor?
bible_quanes.answer: Poor, yet making many rich

bible_quanes.question: With whom does Christ have no accord?
bible_quanes.answer: Belial

bible_quanes.question: What will God be to His people?
bible_quanes.answer: A Father
bible_quanes.explanation: And they His sons and daughters.

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul carry on the right hand and the left?
bible_quanes.answer: The armour of righteousness

bible_quanes.question: What has been opened to the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: Our mouth is open, our heart is enlarged

bible_quanes.question: From what should we cleanse ourselves?
bible_quanes.answer: All filthiness of the flesh and spirit

bible_quanes.question: What does godly sorrow produce?
bible_quanes.answer: Repentance to salvation

bible_quanes.question: How did God comfort Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: By the coming of Titus

bible_quanes.question: What was Paul filled with?
bible_quanes.answer: Comfort, and exceeding joyful in all tribulation

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul face in Macedonia?
bible_quanes.answer: Without were fightings, within were fears

bible_quanes.question: Did Paul regret his earlier letter?
bible_quanes.answer: He did not repent, though he did repent for a season

bible_quanes.question: What did godly sorrow produce in the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: Carefulness, clearing, indignation, fear, vehement desire, zeal and revenge

bible_quanes.question: Why was Titus's spirit refreshed?
bible_quanes.answer: By you all

bible_quanes.question: How did the Corinthians receive Titus?
bible_quanes.answer: With fear and trembling

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul say he had done to no one?
bible_quanes.answer: Wronged, corrupted or defrauded any man

bible_quanes.question: What did Jesus become for our sakes?
bible_quanes.answer: Poor, that we through His poverty might be rich

bible_quanes.question: What makes a gift acceptable?
bible_quanes.answer: A willing mind, accepted according to that a man hath
bible_quanes.explanation: Not what one does not have.

bible_quanes.question: What did the Macedonians' deep poverty produce?
bible_quanes.answer: The riches of their liberality

bible_quanes.question: In what does Paul want the Corinthians to abound?
bible_quanes.answer: This grace also

bible_quanes.question: What did the Macedonians first give?
bible_quanes.answer: Themselves to the Lord

bible_quanes.question: What Scripture does Paul quote about gathering?
bible_quanes.answer: He that had gathered much had nothing over

bible_quanes.question: Whom did God put earnest care into for the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: Titus

bible_quanes.question: Whose praise is in the gospel throughout the churches?
bible_quanes.answer: The brother sent with Titus

bible_quanes.question: What is Paul careful to provide?
bible_quanes.answer: Honest things in the sight of the Lord and of men

bible_quanes.question: What principle does Paul give for giving?
bible_quanes.answer: An equality, that your abundance may be a supply for their want

bible_quanes.question: What kind of giver does God love?
bible_quanes.answer: A cheerful giver

bible_quanes.question: What happens to him who sows sparingly?
bible_quanes.answer: He shall reap also sparingly

bible_quanes.question: What is God able to make abound toward you?
bible_quanes.answer: All grace

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul thank God for in 2 Corinthians 9:15?
bible_quanes.answer: His unspeakable gift

bible_quanes.question: What had Paul boasted to the Macedonians about?
bible_quanes.answer: The forwardness of your mind, that Achaia was ready a year ago

bible_quanes.question: Why did Paul send the brethren ahead?
bible_quanes.answer: To make up beforehand your bounty

bible_quanes.question: What does God supply to the sower?
bible_quanes.answer: Seed, and bread for food
bible_quanes.explanation: He increases the fruits of righteousness.

bible_quanes.question: What does the administration of this service supply?
bible_quanes.answer: The want of the saints, and many thanksgivings unto God

bible_quanes.question: What did the righteous man do, in the scripture Paul quotes in 2 Corinthians 9:9?
bible_quanes.answer: He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor

bible_quanes.question: For what will the recipients glorify God?
bible_quanes.answer: Their professed subjection unto the gospel and their liberal distribution

bible_quanes.question: What are the weapons of our warfare not?
bible_quanes.answer: Carnal

bible_quanes.question: What do we bring into captivity?
bible_quanes.answer: Every thought to the obedience of Christ

bible_quanes.question: In whom should he who glories glory?
bible_quanes.answer: The Lord

bible_quanes.question: By what does Paul plead with the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: The meekness and gentleness of Christ

bible_quanes.question: What did some say about Paul's letters and presence?
bible_quanes.answer: His letters are weighty, but his bodily presence weak

bible_quanes.question: What is unwise, according to 2 Corinthians 10:12?
bible_quanes.answer: Measuring and comparing themselves among themselves

bible_quanes.question: Whom does the Lord commend?
bible_quanes.answer: Not he that commendeth himself, but whom the Lord commendeth

bible_quanes.question: How does Paul boast?
bible_quanes.answer: According to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul cast down?
bible_quanes.answer: Imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God

bible_quanes.question: Where did Paul hope to preach next?
bible_quanes.answer: In the regions beyond you

bible_quanes.question: As what does Satan transform himself?
bible_quanes.answer: An angel of light

bible_quanes.question: How was Eve deceived?
bible_quanes.answer: The serpent beguiled her through his subtilty

bible_quanes.question: How many times did Paul receive forty stripes minus one from the Jews?
bible_quanes.answer: Five times

bible_quanes.question: In what will Paul boast?
bible_quanes.answer: The things which concern his infirmities

bible_quanes.question: To whom did Paul betroth the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: One husband, as a chaste virgin to Christ

bible_quanes.question: To whom was Paul not inferior?
bible_quanes.answer: The very chiefest apostles

bible_quanes.question: How many times was Paul shipwrecked?
bible_quanes.answer: Thrice
bible_quanes.explanation: A night and day in the deep.

bible_quanes.question: Who guarded Damascus to arrest Paul?
bible_quanes.answer: The governor under Aretas the king

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul call the false apostles?
bible_quanes.answer: Deceitful workers transforming themselves into apostles of Christ

bible_quanes.question: What came upon Paul daily?
bible_quanes.answer: The care of all the churches

bible_quanes.question: What did the Lord say to Paul about His grace?
bible_quanes.answer: "My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness"

bible_quanes.question: What was given to Paul to keep him from being exalted?
bible_quanes.answer: A thorn in the flesh

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say when he is weak?
bible_quanes.answer: Then he is strong

bible_quanes.question: How many times did Paul plead for the thorn to depart?
bible_quanes.answer: Thrice

bible_quanes.question: To which heaven was the man in Christ caught up?
bible_quanes.answer: The third heaven

bible_quanes.question: What did the man hear in Paradise?
bible_quanes.answer: Unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul say he seeks?
bible_quanes.answer: Not yours, but you

bible_quanes.question: What will Paul gladly do for the Corinthians' souls?
bible_quanes.answer: Spend and be spent

bible_quanes.question: With what were the signs of an apostle accomplished?
bible_quanes.answer: In all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul send with Titus?
bible_quanes.answer: The brother
bible_quanes.explanation: They walked in the same spirit.

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul tell the Corinthians to examine?
bible_quanes.answer: Yourselves, whether ye be in the faith

bible_quanes.question: What is the final benediction of 2 Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God and the communion of the Holy Ghost

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul tell the Corinthians to be?
bible_quanes.answer: Perfect, of good comfort, of one mind, live in peace

bible_quanes.question: How should they greet one another?
bible_quanes.answer: With a holy kiss

bible_quanes.question: How many times was Paul coming to the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: The third time

bible_quanes.question: By how many witnesses shall every word be established?
bible_quanes.answer: Two or three

bible_quanes.question: How was Christ crucified, and how does He live?
bible_quanes.answer: Crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God

bible_quanes.question: What can we not do against the truth?
bible_quanes.answer: Nothing

bible_quanes.question: Why did Paul write these things while absent?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest he should use sharpness when present

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray for the Corinthians?
bible_quanes.answer: Your perfection
